turns.text: You can also say: "I used to do that," but not anymore.
turns.zh: 你也可以说：“我以前常那样做”，但现在不做了。

turns.text: Or, "I would do that" if it was a habit.
turns.zh: 或者，如果那是个习惯，就说“我以前会那样做”。

turns.text: When I was young, I would paint a lot.
turns.zh: 我年轻的时候，经常画画。

turns.text: So, use different ways of talking about the past, not only the simple past tense.
turns.zh: 所以，要用不同的方式谈论过去，不只是用一般过去时。
